says: `Accounting.change` makes `Quota.Msg.propose` with Schema `make` from the caller's numbers, typed `number` while the fields are `Schema.Finite`.
proof: In: next/packages/libfabrika/src/processes/Quotas.ts:128 the public `change(operation, writes, bytes, at, recovery?)` takes plain numbers, implemented at next/packages/libfabrika/src/processes/QuotasSql.ts:687 with no decode. Make: next/packages/libfabrika/src/processes/QuotasSql.ts:703 `Quota.Msg.cases.propose.make({ at, operation, ... })`, whose `at` is `Schema.Finite` (next/packages/libfabrika/src/processes/internal/quota.ts:49), so `NaN` or `Infinity` throws.
cost: A caller that passes a non-finite count or time gets a throw instead of a typed `QuotasError`. Mostly this threw before #1619 too, at `save` (`Schema.encodeSync`, QuotasSql.ts:40); which callers turn it into a defect was not followed.
